title: Complete Business Onboarding Successfully
description: Verify that Owner/Manager can complete the entire onboarding flow by providing all required tenant-specific data including business name, contact info, units, privacy settings, user roles, product aliases, and optional legal information.

steps.description: Navigate to onboarding page as Owner or Manager
Input valid business name, contact details, and measurement units
Configure privacy settings from Open to Max Secure
Set up user roles including Owner, Manager and Staff
Define product aliases and enter optional legal information
Submit onboarding form
Confirm onboarding completes with success message and user is allowed to proceed to transactional use

title: Enforce Required Fields on Onboarding
description: Verify system prevents proceeding if required fields in onboarding form are missing or invalid.

steps.description: Navigate to onboarding page
Leave required fields like business name or contact info empty
Attempt to submit onboarding form
Form shows validation errors and submission is blocked

title: Multi-tenant Data Isolation Verification
description: Validate that users of one tenant cannot access or view data belonging to another tenant under any scenario.

steps.description: Login as User A from Tenant X
Attempt to access Tenant Y's inventory, sales, user roles, and settings via UI or API
Access is denied or data is inaccessible; no cross-tenant leakage observed

title: Configure and Persist Privacy Presets
description: Verify Owner can configure privacy presets from Open to Max Secure including failsafe mechanisms and that these settings persist and enforce system-wide.

steps.description: Login as Owner and navigate to privacy settings
Set privacy preset to Max Secure
Save settings and reload page
Privacy preset remains Max Secure after reload
Attempt an action disallowed by Max Secure preset
Action is blocked as per privacy preset

title: Inventory Intake with Multi-Unit Conversion and Audit Logging
description: Test inventory intake flow via mobile or web interface with multi-unit conversions and verify detailed audit logs including user details, timestamps, change deltas, and intake reasons.

steps.description: Login as Staff user with intake permission
Navigate to inventory intake page
Enter inventory intake data with units requiring conversion (e.g. boxes to pieces)
Submit intake form
Inventory quantity is correctly updated with unit conversions applied
Audit log entry created with user, timestamp, quantity change, and reason

title: Batch Inventory Intake CSV Import with Audit Trail
description: Verify batch processing of multi-item inventory intake via CSV import works correctly within performance benchmarks and creates corresponding audit logs for each item.

steps.description: Login as authorized user with batch intake permission
Prepare a CSV file with 50 inventory items with valid data
Upload CSV file via batch intake feature
Batch intake completes within 2 seconds per 50 items
Inventory quantities are updated correctly for all items
Audit logs created for all inventory changes with correct details

title: Role-Based Access Control Enforcement
description: Validate that only authorized roles (Owner, Manager) can assign roles, configure settings, and view audit logs, while Staff or other roles are restricted.

steps.description: Login as Staff user
Attempt to assign user roles, modify system settings, or view audit logs
Access denied for these restricted actions
Login as Manager user
Assign user roles, configure settings, and view audit logs
Access granted for permitted actions

title: Sales Transaction Processing with Real-Time Compliance Enforcement
description: Test that sales transactions processed via POS interface obey configured compliance rules and are recorded precisely.

steps.description: Login as Staff user
Input valid sale items into POS system
Attempt to complete sale
Sale is only completed if compliance rules (e.g. age verification, limits) pass
Sale transaction is recorded with accurate data in sales tracking

title: Credit Policy Enforcement and API Validation
description: Verify credit management policies are properly enforced and exposed API endpoints validate inputs and enforce roles.

steps.description: Login as Manager user
Configure credit policies via UI
Credit policies are saved and active
Call credit API endpoints with valid and invalid inputs
API responds appropriately: accepts valid requests, rejects unauthorized or malformed requests

title: User Authentication Flow with MFA Enforcement
description: Validate secure user authentication including login, registration, and onboarding flows with MFA enabled as per system requirements.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input valid username and password
Complete MFA challenge
User is successfully authenticated and redirected to dashboard
Attempt login with incorrect credentials
Authentication fails with appropriate error message

title: Audit Log Integrity and Detail Verification
description: Verify all audit log entries contain complete user details, timestamps, change deltas, change reasons, and that logs are immutable and properly stored.

steps.description: Perform inventory intake and adjustments
Perform sales transaction
Access audit logs as authorized user
Audit logs entries display full correct details and have not been altered

title: Performance Benchmark for Mobile Inventory Intake
description: Measure and verify that mobile inventory intake operations complete within 10 seconds under normal load conditions.

steps.description: Login to mobile interface as Staff
Perform typical inventory intake operation
Operation completes within 10 seconds

title: User Data Deletion per Privacy Settings and Compliance
description: Verify user data deletion requests are honored according to configured privacy presets and compliance mandates like GDPR and HIPAA.

steps.description: Login as Owner and configure privacy preset with data deletion compliance
Submit a data deletion request for a user record
User data is removed or anonymized properly and verifiable

title: POS Settings Configuration and Persistence
description: Test configuring POS settings such as barcode enablement, haptic feedback, and offline mode, and verify these settings persist across sessions and behave correctly.

steps.description: Login as Owner or Manager
Navigate to POS settings page
Toggle barcode enablement, haptic feedback, and offline mode options
Save settings and reload
Settings persist and POS interface behaves accordingly (barcode scanning enabled/disabled, haptic/sound feedback enabled/disabled, offline mode enabled/disabled)

title: AI-Powered Insights Accuracy and Access Control
description: Verify AI-powered operational intelligence features deliver accurate insights and that access is restricted to authorized roles only.

steps.description: Login as Manager or Owner
Access AI insights dashboard
Relevant operational insights are displayed and match underlying data
Login as Staff user
Attempt to access AI insights dashboard
Access denied or hidden UI elements
